cold_checks.definition: Ratio of summed measured single-group uncached fit wall times on the frozen cold-check tasks

evidence.scope: Selected A0/A2 original-MSIC models only; all training arrays regenerated with exact fingerprints; not all candidate matrices; no coefficient or support changed

evidence.excluded_scope: test_phase_c not collected because optional sklearn is absent; no baseline source changed; whole repository not tested

runtime_note: Shared-cache elapsed is not a cold-fit measurement. Standalone cost estimates add cached fixed fit_seconds. Cold checks are separate measured single-group fits.
uncertainty: Five repetitions per scenario support broad paired screening, not definitive scenario-wise statistical claims; keep interval and cap limitations explicit
